response.sql: WITH status_totals AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY si.healtheval), status_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_scan_minute) AS mean_average FROM status_totals) SELECT st.status, st.total_scancount, st.avg_gb_per_scan_minute, st.avg_gb_per_scan_minute - sm.mean_average AS gap_from_mean FROM status_totals AS st CROSS JOIN status_mean AS sm WHERE sm.mean_average IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: A zero scan duration is excluded from the average because GB per minute is undefined for it.
